title: Patent Genesis Artifact Series No. 1 + MHCN-3 Dual-Mode Evidence Receipt Spec: A Bitcoin-Anchored 32-Byte Seed Reconstructing a Byte-Identical Original (U.S. Patent Application 19/693,343, public citation)
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Errors are disclosed, not erased. This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All payloads synthetic; no customer-identifiable data appears in this record (POL-DISC-001).

Patent Genesis Artifact — Series No. 1, tied to U.S. Patent Application No. 19/693,343 (programmable satoshi tokenization; public citation only). An original 51,560-byte blueprint artwork that exists nowhere as a stored file: it is fully determined by a 32-byte seed (SHA-256 81d4a5cb...) anchored to the Bitcoin blockchain via OpenTimestamps (digest-only; no tokens, wallets, or crypto-assets). Reconstruction was verified twice from independent runs: byte-identical, PNG SHA-256 4b4fbf0e... Same seed in, same art out — the hash is the artifact.

This record also seals MHCN-3, the dual-mode evidence receipt spec (v0.3, pilot-ready): digest mode (existence only) and seed mode (existence + possession + reconstruction), with generator pinning (SBOM doctrine), an information-theoretic domain-honesty rule (seed mode applies only to generator-produced artifacts; no overclaiming), a security-inversion rule (never seed-anchor confidential artifacts), and a seven-point pilot gate. MHCN-3 extends MHCN-1 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23445938) and MHCN-2 v0.2 as amended by Council Session 04 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23446655).

Scope and honesty: the generator in this bundle is a demonstrative artwork generator, not the patent's method; no invention method detail is disclosed (patent-then-publish doctrine). The patent is cited by public reference only. Reconstruction proves existence, possession, and byte-parity — not legal title, ownership, or truth (R9 legal non-assertion).

Dual Mesh Benchmark: MEASURED (scoped) — this record documents a deterministic reconstruction demo and a spec; no neural-mesh inference was involved. Program benchmark: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23321637 (DeepSeek column: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241). Provenance: append-only ledger entries 0182-0183, github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen. Two-key curation: drafted and vetted by the system (Gabriel), published on the owner's explicit GO (chat authorization, 2026-10-18 ~01:10 CT).

VERSION 2.0 (2026-10-18): v1.0 layout defect disclosed and fixed. The first-minted Series No. 1 artwork had rendering defects (title-block text overflow, graphic collisions), identified by the owner at minting. Unaffected and re-verified: reconstruction determinism (v1.1 PNG SHA-256 3c130d66..., byte-identical across runs), seed integrity (SHA-256 81d4a5cb..., unchanged), and the Bitcoin anchor (unchanged). v1.0 files retained in this bundle per the append-only doctrine; v1.1 generator (pinned per R12) is canonical. Defect disclosed, not erased — ledger entry 0184.
